annotations.title: Read back a saved triage profile

description: Returns a saved fixRAgent assessment by its diagnosis_id (from an assessment, or the last part of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link). Read only: it never re-reads the photo, never calls the model and spends nothing from the daily allowance. It takes one id and returns one assessment with no contact details of any kind.

diagnosis_id.description: The UUID of a saved assessment, or the last path segment of a fixragent.com/c/<id> link.

name: get_triage_profile
